stocks.headline: Fell 5.9% to 155.38, then slipped to 153.82 after hours, as Huang's return drew political fire. Morning call: right.
stocks.why: The business did not change today. Sales grew 106% and profit per share kept pace, margins are improving and next year's forecast rose 28% in 90 days. At 21× trailing profit, the lowest in 5 years, the stock is cheap. The damage is political. Republicans and an op-ed say the president forcing Huang back is a national-security risk, the FBI and the Attorney General would not discuss an investigation, and Huang told staff Nvidia needs no succession plan. That keeps a lid on the stock and pulls down its suppliers (MU, TSM, ARM, SMCI) and buyers like CRWV.

long_term.reason: The earnings power is strong and the price is cheap. Still, the CEO and governance story is getting worse, and an investigation or new limits on China sales would hit the stock directly, so don't add yet.
